content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

For muscle building, aim for 1.6–2.2g of protein per kg of body weight daily—that's the sweet spot backed by research. Since you're pushing for 100kg bench press in three months, staying at the higher end (around 2g/kg) will support recovery and growth, especially with consistent training like your push day work 💪

Spread it across 4–5 meals to maximize muscle protein synthesis, and prioritize complete proteins (meat, fish, eggs, dairy) or combine plant sources to get all amino acids.

What's your current body weight? That'll help you nail down your exact target.
